reason: The cited evidence directly shows FSP pre-weld treatment refines grain structure in AA6061 (E2, E3) and reduces solidification cracking (E2). The mechanism linking grain refinement to reduced cracking is supported by E1 (nanoparticle addition) and E2 (epitaxial growth role). However, the hypothesis overstates the certainty of the mechanism, as E2 notes the effect on solidification cracking was not previously addressed and requires further investigation.
